summary: Implementation plan for cleaning up the Project Orion codebase and repository: removing temporary public/assets/aistudio uploads and screenshots, updating root files (COMMIT_SUMMARY.md, README.md, .gitignore, package.json), pruning unused npm dependencies (express, dotenv, @google/genai, motion), auditing and removing dead functions/unused types/duplicate helpers while preserving the current file layout, and syncing all [ORION-ANCHOR] tags and regenerating the public/wiki index.
